quantification_strategy: relative abundance based on extracted ion chromatogram areas

acquisition: Tandem MS (MS/MS) data were acquired using a data-dependent method
The top 15 most intense ions were selected for higher energy collisional dissociation (HCD)
Data-dependent parameters were as follows: minimum AGC target 7e3
labeling: relative abundance resulted from the sum of the extracted ion chromatogram areas
quantification: The relative abundance resulted from the sum of the extracted ion chromatogram areas for each glycan structure in relation to the sum of chromatographic areas of all identified glycans.
